serviceDetails.title: What causes sludge in a heating system?
paras: Over time, water and metal inside your pipes and radiators react and form a black sludge of rust and debris. The sludge settles at the bottom of radiators, blocks pipes and valves, and clogs the parts inside your boiler. Your system then has to work harder and burn more gas to keep your home warm.
serviceDetails.alt: Radiator cold at the bottom from sludge build up

serviceDetails.title: How do I know I need a power flush?
list: Radiators cold at the bottom or in the middle
Noisy boiler or pipes: banging, kettling or gurgling
Dark or black water when you bleed a radiator
Frequent boiler breakdowns or pump problems
Cold spots which come back after bleeding
serviceDetails.alt: Signs a heating system needs a power flush

serviceDetails.title: How does a power flush work?
paras: We connect a power flush pump to your heating system and push a strong flow of water and cleaning chemical through the pipes and radiators. We work through each radiator in turn, loosening and pushing out the sludge. When the water runs clear, we refill the system with fresh water and add inhibitor to protect it from new sludge forming.
serviceDetails.alt: Power flush machine connected to a boiler system

serviceDetails.title: What are the benefits of a power flush?
paras: A clean system brings real gains:
list: Radiators heat evenly from top to bottom
Less strain on the boiler and pump, which can help them last longer
Less gas used for the same warmth
serviceDetails.alt: Radiator heating evenly after a power flush

serviceDetails.title: Do I need a power flush before a new boiler?
paras: Often, yes. Sludge from an old system can flow into a new boiler and damage it. Many boiler makers recommend cleaning the system when a new boiler goes in, and a dirty system can affect your warranty. We check your system water when we quote for a new boiler, and tell you whether a flush is needed.
serviceDetails.alt: Power flush before a new boiler installation

serviceDetails.title: How long does it take and how much does it cost?
paras: Most power flushes take a few hours, depending on the size of your system and how many radiators you have. The price depends on the same things. We give you a fixed price before we start, with no hidden extras.

serviceDetails.title: How do I keep my system clean after a flush?
paras: After the flush, we add inhibitor to the system water, which slows down new sludge forming. A yearly boiler service is a good time to check the inhibitor level and top it up. Some homes also benefit from a magnetic filter on the boiler, which catches debris before it reaches the boiler. Ask us and we will advise if one suits your system.

faqs.q: How do I know I need a power flush?
faqs.a: Look for cold spots on radiators, slow warm up times, noisy pipes or a noisy boiler, and dark water when you bleed a radiator.

faqs.q: How long does a power flush take?
faqs.a: Most take a few hours, depending on the size of your system.

faqs.q: How often should I power flush?
faqs.a: Around every five to six years, or sooner if cold spots or noise come back.

faqs.q: Will a power flush help my bills?
faqs.a: Often, yes. A clean system heats faster and uses less gas.

faqs.q: Do I need a power flush before a new boiler?
faqs.a: Often, yes. It stops old sludge damaging the new boiler and helps protect your warranty.

faqs.q: Will a power flush fix a leak?
faqs.a: No. A flush cleans the system. If we find a leak, we tell you and quote to repair it.
No. The system is sealed while we flush, and we protect your floors and clean up afterwards.

faqs.q: Can bleeding my radiators fix cold spots?
faqs.a: Bleeding fixes cold spots at the top, caused by air. Cold spots at the bottom are usually sludge, which needs a flush.

faqs.q: Do I need a magnetic filter?
faqs.a: A magnetic filter catches debris before it reaches the boiler. We advise if one suits your system.

faqs.q: Can a power flush damage old pipes?
faqs.a: A flush can show up weak spots in very old pipes or radiators. We check your system first and tell you of any risk before we start.

faqs.q: How much does a power flush cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your system and the number of radiators. We give you a fixed price before we start.
